items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know that Frenchy was stealing all -- just little insignificant money every week, you know.

ctx.x: -- thing, when I left Louis Armstrong and I went to get my unemployment and I put it in and because New York and California, at that time, you worked together, you know for unemployment, so when the -- you have to wait two weeks before you get it and so after two weeks I went over -- nothing for me, so I say, well maybe they didn't straighten out the -- the guys says fill out your thing for next week. So I fill it out -- fill them out for about 12 weeks and then, I'm not getting anything. So one day, what

is this business? So the guy says -- says let's go in the back he wanted to talk he left his cage and give it to somebody else. So we sat down and we talked and he says, well, New York says they haven't got anything on -- on you. So I said well that's funny, so I says, what do you mean they don't have anything? And I was telling him my case, you know, so that I didn't know that Frenchy was stealing all -- just little insignificant money every week, you know. So he says, look, he says, have you gotten your weekly…

I say, yeah, I got everyone, which I did. Had all of them, so he says, okay, I'll tell you what I'll do for you. He said I'll call the head office downtown and they can have a date for you and you go down there and you tell them the whole bit. I said, okay, so they called me and then he said -- I forget the day, but he said you go on down there, he says, ask for Mr. So-and-so, and he'll take care of you.
